theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U V K : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n) (d ε H α : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u U → K ⊆ U → d ≠ 0 → (∀ x ∈ V, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, x + (t * d) • e ∈ K) → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ ε) → (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖fderiv ℝ u x - fderiv ℝ u y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => d⁻¹ • (u (z + d • e) - u z)) V ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (u (z + d • e) - u z)) x = d⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ u (x + d • e) - fderiv ℝ u x)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, ‖d⁻¹ • (u (x + d • e) - u x)‖ ≤ ε * ‖e‖) ∧ ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (u (z + d • e) - u z)) x - fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (u (z + d • e) - u z)) y‖ ≤ 2 * |d|⁻¹ * H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
